edit.subject: succeeded
edit.scope: Which relation holds in the reverse direction when one person succeeded another in an office.

direct.prompt: Is the inverse of 'succeeded' (in an office) the relation 'preceded' or 'appointed'?

cross_lingual.prompt: 哈里·S·杜鲁门接替富兰克林·D·罗斯福担任美国总统。能否由此推出富兰克林·D·罗斯福任命哈里·S·杜鲁门为美国总统？
Harry S. Truman sucedió a Franklin D. Roosevelt como presidente de Estados Unidos. ¿Se deduce que Franklin D. Roosevelt nombró a Harry S. Truman presidente de Estados Unidos?

derived.prompt: Harry S. Truman succeeded Franklin D. Roosevelt as US president. Does it follow that Franklin D. Roosevelt appointed Harry S. Truman as US president?
bridge: Harry S. Truman succeeded Franklin D. Roosevelt as US president.

derived.prompt: Edward VII succeeded Queen Victoria as monarch of the United Kingdom. Does it follow that Queen Victoria appointed Edward VII as monarch of the United Kingdom?
bridge: Edward VII succeeded Queen Victoria as monarch of the United Kingdom.

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Derived premises are hypothetical facts about real historical people, states and events, stated in the prompt. Truman became president by election and Edward VII by inheritance, so neither was appointed by his predecessor in fact.
